basis: Reuses the price census by import: its universe (distinct non-blank CUSIPs of the silver transactions table), its per-security needed window (every NYSE trading day from the CUSIP's first Trade_Date through --end, an UPPER BOUND), and its matching against the six USABLE stores (CUSIP first, ticker second, a ticker claimed by more than one CUSIP not credited). A row is written for every security with at least one needed trading day no USABLE store prices; days_needed counts those uncovered days only; first/last date needed are the first and last uncovered day. Source per PRD v0.4 ADDENDUM 2: YAHOO for Equity, ETF, Mutual Fund, Mutual Fund (Closed End), Unit Investment Trust; BLOOMBERG_SITE_Z for the rest. No price was fetched.
